text:
maria: Heads-up — customers reporting intermittent 502s from eu-edge for embeddings. Root cause: header sanitizer edge case. PR 4951 fixes it. Can we expedite a hotfix to eu-edge? :shield:
release_mgr: paste PR and a one-line rollback plan pls. Need ops + oncall thumbs for expedite.
maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4951 — one-line fix. Rollback = redeploy image redwood-main-2026-04-05 tag, ~4m. No DB/migration.
sre_lead: propose 3% canary for 8m, watch error-rate and p95. Pin image tag during rollout. If metric trend improves, promote.
ops-rotation: oncall checked traces, matches header parser. +1 for expedite after canary healthy.
ci-bot: CI green. image:redwood-hotfix-4951 built and pushed.
releasebot: deploy command: `./bin/deploy --env eu-edge --image redwood-hotfix-4951 --canary 3% --timeout 8m`
release_mgr: issuing deploy now. output: `deploy-job 11011 started, creating canary (3%)`
deploybot: canary up (1 small instance in eu-west1). healthchecks passing. errors in canary reduced.
sre_lead: observing 8m window: error-rate down in canary, no latency regressions. Recommend promote.
release_mgr: promoting to 100% -> `./bin/promote --job 11011 --to 100%`
deploybot: promotion started, rolling image:redwood-hotfix-4951 to eu-edge. draining old pods.
releasebot: deployment complete. All eu-edge nodes now on redwood-hotfix-4951. Post-deploy metrics: p50/p95 stable, error-rate returned to baseline.
maria: thanks all — filing release note and backport to stable branch. :memo:
ops-rotation: will monitor for 30m and update the incident ticket if anything pops.
release_mgr: closing as expedited hotfix deployed. rollback command noted in ticket.
